name: CivicMesh Relief Coordinator Network
description: A browser-executable multi-agent network that coordinates emergency shelters, supply inventories, and federated peer clinic/transit networks with strict JSON Schema validation and human-in-the-loop write approvals.

agents.name: relief_coordinator

function.description: Front-end orchestrator that receives resident or volunteer emergency requests, delegates to local shelter/dispatch specialists and federated peer networks (clinics and transit), and proposes human-approved actions.

request.description: The natural language emergency or community aid request.

agents.instructions: You are the CivicMesh Relief Coordinator. Always gather live facts before proposing write actions. First consult shelter_specialist for shelter availability and supplies. If medical needs (insulin, oxygen, first aid, prescription) are mentioned, call the federated peer metro-clinic-triage/clinic_triage_agent. If travel, wheelchair access, or flooding/bridge closures are relevant, call the federated peer saferoute-transit-feed/transit_router_agent. Finally, delegate bed reservations or aid dispatches to dispatch_planner, which will request explicit human approval before changing site state.

agents.name: shelter_specialist

function.description: Queries live local shelter bed capacity, wheelchair accessibility, pet friendliness, backup power, and emergency supply inventory on the host CivicMesh site.

agents.instructions: Use local read-only site actions query_shelters and check_supply_inventory to return accurate, verified shelter matches and stock levels. Never invent capacities.

agents.name: dispatch_planner

function.description: Prepares schema-validated shelter bed reservations and mobile aid dispatch tickets. Every write action requires explicit human-in-the-loop approval before execution.

agents.instructions: Validate every field strictly against the site action JSON Schema before calling site://reserve_shelter_bed or site://create_aid_dispatch. Always summarize the exact impact clearly for the human reviewer.

site_actions.name: query_shelters
site_actions.description: Search open community shelters by district, accessibility, backup power, and available bed count.

site_actions.name: check_supply_inventory
site_actions.description: Inspect real-time emergency supply counts across distribution hubs.

site_actions.name: reserve_shelter_bed
site_actions.description: Hold beds at a verified community shelter for an incoming resident or family. Decrements live bed availability.

site_actions.name: create_aid_dispatch
site_actions.description: Create an active mobile aid or volunteer courier dispatch ticket linked to a shelter or district.
